title: Repurposing — Content Multiplier
summary: One strong piece becomes several — adapt for each platform, not copy-paste.

sections.heading: Orientation
sections.subtitle: Introduction
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **What will you understand?** A **strong piece of content** can become several — **but each platform has its own format** — **no copy-pasting**.
- **Why now?** After editing, you have **clearer content**. **Repurposing** allows the same idea to reach **more platforms** **without starting from scratch**.
- **After the lesson:** You take **one idea, post, or script** — and transform it into **three different formats**.

sections.heading: Tension
sections.subtitle: A Familiar Situation
sections.contentMarkdown:
- You take the same long post and share it on Facebook, LinkedIn, and X — and the result is weak on every platform.
- This is not **Repurposing** — it’s **copy-pasting**. Each platform has a different rhythm, length, and tone.
- **AI** helps you extract ideas, summarize, and rephrase — and you choose what remains authentic and useful.

sections.heading: Core Idea
sections.subtitle: Adaptation — No Copying
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **Repurposing** means keeping the **same core idea** but in formats that suit each platform: **short reel**, **LinkedIn post**, **X thread**, **newsletter paragraph**, **story questions**.
- A **single long video or post** can produce: **three short scripts**, **a professional post**, **five engagement questions**.
- **AI suggests formats** — you review: **Does the tone still sound like you? Is the information useful in this form?**
- **Example Prompt:** «Transform this content into: 1) a short LinkedIn post 2) three short video scripts 3) five story questions 4) a newsletter paragraph — and make each version suitable for its platform.»

sections.heading: Comparison
sections.subtitle: Copying the Same Text or Smart Adaptation?
sections.contentMarkdown:
| Copying the Same Text | Adapting with AI |
|----------------------|------------------|
| A **500-word post** on LinkedIn and X — people skip it. **One format** doesn’t fit everywhere. | The **same idea:** **a thread of 5 tweets**, **a 45-second reel**, **one story question** — each serves the platform.

sections.heading: Glossary
sections.subtitle: Two Terms for Repurposing
sections.contentMarkdown:
| Term | Meaning | Example |
|------|---------|--------|
| **Repurposing** | **Transforming an original piece** into **multiple formats** with platform adjustments | **8-minute video → 3 short clips + summary post** |
| **Format Adaptation** | **Changing length, tone, and structure** based on where it’s published | **The same advice:** **a strong sentence on X** — **a paragraph story on LinkedIn** |

sections.subtitle: From Original to Formats

2. **AI suggests formats for each platform**
3. **You choose and edit** — **publish with confidence**

sections.heading: Quiz
sections.subtitle: Quick Check
sections.contentMarkdown:
> **Quiz key:** correctIndex: 1

**Question:** You have a **10-minute video** about a marketing tip. What is the best **Repurposing**?

Post the video link** on all platforms **with the same comment**.**
**Ask AI for** a **short reel + LinkedIn post + 3 story questions** — and edit each one.
Copy the first 3 minutes as text on X** **without editing**.**

**Explanation:** **Repurposing = adapting for each platform**. **AI speeds up the process** — **the judgment and authenticity are yours.**

sections.heading: Mission
sections.subtitle: One Idea → Three Formats
sections.contentMarkdown:
**Introduction:** **A process of multiplying** — **not mandatory posting**. **Choose an idea, post, or script** — **transform it into three different formats** — **edit what doesn’t sound like you**. **10–20 minutes is enough**.

**Submission:** Original · Format 1 (platform + content) · Format 2 · Format 3 · One edit for authenticity

**Evaluation Criteria:**

| Dimension | Weight | Criteria |
|-----------|--------|----------|
| Three Different Formats | 60% | **Each format for a different platform or form** — **no copying the same text** |
| Your Judgment | 40% | **One edit** that shows you reviewed and chose your voice |

sections.heading: Confidence Close
